name: Resonance Field Saga — pronunciation lexicon
notes: Single source of truth for invented-name pronunciation. Curated allow-list only (Risk A2: never a fuzzy pass). 'match' strings are matched case-insensitively, whole-word, tolerant of straight/curly apostrophes and a trailing possessive. 'alias' is the ElevenLabs .pls respelling (works on all EL models). 'say' is the plain-text respelling for engines without a dictionary (Speechify), kept to a single token so word-sync stays 1:1. 'ipa' enriches EL flash_v2/v3 where supported. Respellings are first-pass, to be tuned by ear (Phase A acceptance). v1.1 (2026-07-23): retuned Ka'el, Eirenos, Mara, Malakai by ear on ElevenLabs — aliases now use spaced syllables so EL's G2P reads them cleanly; the other six were confirmed correct. v1.2 (2026-07-23): Eirenos retuned to 'Heir Rain Oss' (air-RAIN-oss) after second ear-check; the other three v1.1 fixes confirmed correct.
